units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 82a:5">B. Mets. 82ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shevuot 43b:6">Shebu. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>ההיא דאוזפיה … ק׳ דמגלא וכ׳</he> if one lends to his neighbor a thousand Zuz, and the latter leaves as a pledge the handle of a saw; <he>אבד ק׳ וכ׳</he> if the handle is lost, the loan is lost.
<cite ref="Shevuot 43b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>אבל ק׳ ונסכא</he> but if he deposits a handle and a silver bar.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 103a:7">B. Mets. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>מהדר ליה קַתֵּיה</he> he returns to him the handle (of the broken mattock).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 27b:1">Snh. 27ᵇ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="B00357"><he>בּוּרְטְיָא</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="S00047"><he>קַתַּיָּא</he></cite>, <he>קַתָּתָא</he>, <cite ref="S02283"><he>קַתָּתֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 30b:5">Pes. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>קַתַּיְיהוּ בטינא וכ׳</he> cover the helves of the knives with clay &c.

<cite ref="Beitzah 33b">Bets. 33ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 37b">Yoma 37ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01257"><he>נַרְגָּא</he></cite>. Shebu. l. c. <he>קתתי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="S02283"><he>קִתָּאתֵי</he></cite>).
